messages:
Marta (Billing): Heads-up: Saw a small but scary pattern in last night's run: a few customers got two invoices (same period) and some invoices missing the promotional discount line. Likely cause: exporter retried while discount-service was timing out.
Ethan (Eng): job id and logs?
Marta (Billing): job invoice-batch-2026-04-12-01. Snippet:
```
invoice_id: inv_20260412_042
customer: gamma-inc
lines:
  - usage_compute: 450.00
  # missing promo_discount: -50.00
```
Marta (Billing): For the duplicate, we have two separate invoice_ids but they were both exported to Stripe within minutes; one was finalized and the other remained a draft but payment hook doubled up in staging.
billing-bot: invoice-batch-2026-04-12-01 completed: 9 warnings, 3 errors. Errors: MISSING_DISCOUNT_LINE, EXPORT_RETRY_DUPLICATE
Vivek (Payments): If a finalized invoice exists and a duplicate draft is later paid, we risk double-charge. Any charges already happened?
Marta (Billing): In staging a duplicated finalization triggered two payment attempts for the same customer external id; one was declined but could have succeeded in prod.
Ethan (Eng): Root cause looks like exporter does not atomically record external_export_id before retrying. If discount-service times out, the assembler emits an invoice without discount then exporter retries the whole invoice and the discount later appears. Two exports => duplicate entries.
Nina (RevOps): Action items: pause live exports for that night, compile list of duplicate invoice ids and missing-discount invoices, notify Account Managers for any customers that might see changes.
Vivek (Payments): Pause exports please. Also we should check webhook idempotency handling; Stripe webhooks may deliver duplicate events and our handler must dedupe by invoice.external_id.
Ethan (Eng): Quick mitigation: exporter should write a ledger row "export_in_progress" with a unique key and block concurrent retries; also add a pre-export check that required discount lines exist for customers with active promos. I'll open a PR for the guard.
Marta (Billing): I'll prepare CSV of affected invoice_ids and owners. Preliminary: 8 customers with missing discount lines, 4 duplicate invoice pairs. Will post to #sales-ops.
Nina (RevOps): Once patched, re-export only the affected invoices using idempotent keys. For any that were charged twice, Finance will issue immediate refunds/credit memos and notify customers.
Ethan (Eng): Tests to add: exporter must assert invoice_keys are unique and promo lines present when customer has promo flag. Canary deploy in ~2 hours. Full fix tomorrow AM.
Marta (Billing): Thanks. Holding exports for that batch now. Drafting customer comms for AM. :wave:
